name: Erasmus+ Mobility Grant (study abroad)
provider: European Commission / Erasmus+
coverage_en: Monthly grant approx. EUR 200-500 for 3-12 months abroad plus tuition-fee exemption at the host institution; top-ups for students with fewer opportunities.
coverage_it: Contributo mensile ~200-500 EUR per 3-12 mesi all'estero + esenzione tasse nell'ateneo ospitante.
eligibility_en: Students enrolled at a higher education institution holding an Erasmus Charter, doing a study period at a partner institution abroad.
eligibility_it: Studenti iscritti a un ateneo con Carta Erasmus, per un periodo di studio presso un partner all'estero.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) Scholarship
provider: European Commission / Erasmus+
coverage_en: Full scholarship: EU contribution EUR 1,400/month for up to 24 months, plus travel, installation and participation costs including health insurance.
coverage_it: Borsa completa: 1.400 EUR/mese fino a 24 mesi + viaggio, installazione e assicurazione.
eligibility_en: Students worldwide holding a first degree, admitted to an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master delivered by a consortium in at least three countries.
eligibility_it: Studenti di tutto il mondo con una prima laurea, ammessi a un master congiunto Erasmus Mundus in almeno tre paesi.

name: DAAD Scholarships
provider: DAAD (German Academic Exchange Service)
coverage_en: Monthly stipend (e.g. EUR 992 students, EUR 1,300 doctoral) plus flat-rate travel allowance; not repayable.
coverage_it: Stipendio mensile (es. 992 EUR studenti, 1.300 dottorandi) + viaggio forfettario; non rimborsabile.
eligibility_en: Primarily international graduates, doctoral students and postdocs for study/research in Germany.
eligibility_it: Laureati internazionali, dottorandi e postdoc per studio/ricerca in Germania.

name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship
provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs / Campus France
coverage_en: Monthly stipend EUR 2,100 (from Jan 2026) plus international transport, insurance, housing search and cultural activities; tuition exemption for national diplomas at public institutions.
coverage_it: Stipendio 2.100 EUR/mese (dal 2026) + trasporto, assicurazione, alloggio; esenzione tasse nei diplomi nazionali pubblici.
eligibility_en: International (non-French) students nominated by a French institution for a master's or PhD.
eligibility_it: Studenti internazionali (non francesi) nominati da un ateneo francese per master o dottorato.

name: Invest Your Talent in Italy
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAECI), ICE, Uni-Italia
coverage_en: Full tuition exemption plus EUR 10,000 stipend disbursed quarterly.
coverage_it: Esenzione totale tasse + 10.000 EUR di stipendio (trimestrale).
eligibility_en: Citizens of eligible listed countries, for English-taught master's in engineering, architecture/design, economics/management.
eligibility_it: Cittadini di paesi idonei, per master in inglese in ingegneria, architettura/design, economia/management.

name: DSU regional scholarship (Diritto allo Studio Universitario)
provider: Italian regional DSU agencies
coverage_en: Means-tested (ISEE): tuition exemption, accommodation, meals and annual cash grant; varies by region/income.
coverage_it: Su base ISEE: esenzione tasse, alloggio, mensa e contributo annuale; varia per regione/reddito.
eligibility_en: Enrolled students (Italian and international, incl. non-EU) below regional income/asset thresholds.
eligibility_it: Studenti iscritti (italiani e internazionali, anche extra-UE) sotto le soglie regionali di reddito.

name: Holland Scholarship
provider: Dutch Ministry of Education / Nuffic and participating institutions
coverage_en: One-time EUR 5,000 paid in the first year.
coverage_it: Una tantum 5.000 EUR nel primo anno.
eligibility_en: Non-EEA international students enrolling in a bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch institution.
eligibility_it: Studenti internazionali extra-SEE iscritti a triennale o magistrale in un ateneo olandese aderente.

name: Orange Tulip Scholarship (OTS)
provider: Nuffic Neso offices with participating institutions
coverage_en: Awards varying by university, from partial tuition waivers to full tuition, some with living allowance.
coverage_it: Premi variabili per ateneo: da esenzioni parziali a copertura totale delle tasse, alcuni con indennita.
eligibility_en: Citizens of specific Neso countries admitted to a participating Dutch programme.
eligibility_it: Cittadini di specifici paesi Neso ammessi a un programma olandese aderente.

name: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect Scholarships
provider: VLIR-UOS (Flemish Interuniversity Council)
coverage_en: Covers tuition, travel, insurance and living expenses for the full programme.
coverage_it: Copre tasse, viaggio, assicurazione e spese di vitto e alloggio per l'intero programma.
eligibility_en: Applicants from 29 eligible developing countries admitted to selected English-taught Flemish programmes.
eligibility_it: Candidati da 29 paesi in via di sviluppo ammessi a programmi in inglese delle Fiandre.

name: ARES Scholarships
provider: ARES (Wallonia-Brussels Federation)
coverage_en: Covers tuition, international travel, subsistence allowance, registration, visa and insurance.
coverage_it: Copre tasse, viaggio internazionale, indennita di sussistenza, iscrizione, visto e assicurazione.
eligibility_en: Residents/professionals of eligible partner countries for advanced bachelor/master or continuing education.
eligibility_it: Residenti/professionisti di paesi partner per master avanzati o formazione continua.

name: MAEC-AECID Scholarships
provider: Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID)
coverage_en: Depending on call: monthly stipend (~EUR 1,200), tuition contribution, travel and insurance.
coverage_it: A seconda del bando: stipendio mensile (~1.200 EUR), contributo tasse, viaggio e assicurazione.
eligibility_en: International and Spanish graduates, mostly postgraduate; some calls target developing countries.
eligibility_it: Laureati internazionali e spagnoli, soprattutto post-laurea; alcuni bandi per paesi in via di sviluppo.

name: Ernst Mach Grant
provider: OeAD (Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation)
coverage_en: Monthly grant plus insurance and travel/installation support, depending on variant.
coverage_it: Contributo mensile + assicurazione e supporto viaggio/installazione, secondo la variante.
eligibility_en: PhD students, postgraduates, postdocs and young lecturers from foreign universities for short stays (not full degree).
eligibility_it: Dottorandi, post-laurea, postdoc e giovani docenti esteri per soggiorni brevi (non laurea intera).

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
provider: Swiss Confederation / SERI
coverage_en: Funded scholarship for research or study at Swiss universities/federal institutes; benefits vary by country/type.
coverage_it: Borsa per ricerca o studio in atenei svizzeri; benefici variabili per paese/tipo.
eligibility_en: Early-career researchers from ~180 countries with a master's, with a confirmed Swiss host supervisor.
eligibility_it: Ricercatori a inizio carriera da ~180 paesi con master, con un supervisore ospitante svizzero confermato.

name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
provider: Swedish Institute (SI)
coverage_en: Full tuition, monthly living stipend SEK 12,000, travel grant SEK 15,000, medical insurance, SI network.
coverage_it: Tasse complete, stipendio SEK 12.000/mese, viaggio SEK 15.000, assicurazione medica, network SI.
eligibility_en: Citizens of listed eligible countries with work/leadership experience, admitted to an eligible English-taught master's.
eligibility_it: Cittadini di paesi idonei con esperienza lavorativa, ammessi a un master idoneo in inglese.

name: Danish Government Scholarships under the Cultural Agreements
provider: Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science
coverage_en: Covers tuition and a monthly grant ~DKK 6,090 (before tax) towards living costs.
coverage_it: Copre tasse + contributo mensile ~DKK 6.090 (lordo) per le spese di vita.
eligibility_en: Highly qualified master's/PhD exchange students from eligible countries (Europe, China, Japan, Israel, Egypt, Russia).
eligibility_it: Studenti master/PhD molto qualificati in scambio da paesi idonei (Europa, Cina, Giappone, Israele, Egitto, Russia).

name: University tuition-fee scholarships / waivers
provider: Individual Finnish universities (no national government scholarship)
coverage_en: Tuition waivers 50-100%; some include relocation/living grant (e.g. University of Helsinki 100% waiver + EUR 5,000 relocation grant).
coverage_it: Esenzioni tasse 50-100%; alcune con contributo di trasferimento (es. Univ. Helsinki esenzione 100% + 5.000 EUR).
eligibility_en: Non-EU/EEA fee-paying students admitted to an English-taught programme; via the programme application.
eligibility_it: Studenti extra-UE/SEE paganti, ammessi a un programma in inglese; tramite la domanda al programma.

name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
provider: Higher Education Authority (HEA)
coverage_en: Stipend EUR 10,000 for one year plus a full tuition fee waiver from the host institution.
coverage_it: Stipendio 10.000 EUR per un anno + esenzione totale delle tasse dall'ateneo ospitante.
eligibility_en: Non-EU/EEA students for one year of full-time study at NFQ level 9 or 10.
eligibility_it: Studenti extra-UE/SEE per un anno a tempo pieno a livello NFQ 9 o 10 (master/dottorato).

name: Stefan Banach NAWA Scholarship Programme
provider: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
coverage_en: Monthly stipend PLN 2,500, tuition exemption at public universities, preparatory course (Polish track), travel allowance PLN 2,500.
coverage_it: Stipendio PLN 2.500/mese, esenzione tasse negli atenei pubblici, corso preparatorio, viaggio PLN 2.500.
eligibility_en: Citizens of 36 Polish Aid partner countries, for full-time master's in Polish or English.
eligibility_it: Cittadini di 36 paesi partner dell'aiuto polacco, per master a tempo pieno in polacco o inglese.

name: Government Scholarships for Developing Countries
provider: Czech Ministry of Education (MEYS)
coverage_en: Scholarship for study at Czech public HEIs in Czech or English (master's and doctoral) under development cooperation.
coverage_it: Borsa per studio in atenei pubblici cechi in ceco o inglese (master e dottorato) nella cooperazione allo sviluppo.
eligibility_en: Citizens of a defined list of eligible developing countries for follow-up master's and doctoral programmes.
eligibility_it: Cittadini di una lista definita di paesi in via di sviluppo per master e dottorati.

name: Camoes Institute Scholarships
provider: Camoes - Instituto da Cooperacao e da Lingua
coverage_en: Scholarships for Portuguese language/culture courses and, under bilateral cooperation, for higher education; paid monthly/quarterly by the Embassy.
coverage_it: Borse per corsi di lingua/cultura portoghese e, nella cooperazione bilaterale, per l'alta formazione; pagate dall'Ambasciata.
eligibility_en: Foreign students for Portuguese language/culture, and nationals of Portuguese-speaking African countries and East Timor under cooperation programmes.
eligibility_it: Studenti stranieri per lingua/cultura, e cittadini dei PALOP e Timor Est nei programmi di cooperazione.
